why:
The briefs handle all four must_catch items.
1. Check 3 runs `node B c1.jsonl missing.jsonl b.jsonl` in one command. It requires exit 2, stderr naming missing.jsonl, and "stdout must still contain the b.jsonl:2 and b.jsonl:3 lines". So the missing file and the bad rows are tested together.
2. Check 4 runs `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js`, which compares the head with the base commit.
3. Builder step 5 says "Update packages/jsonl-lint/README.md" and lists the usage, stdin, order and exit codes it must describe.
4. Check 6 uses `gh pr view` for the body and headRefOid and `gh pr checks` on the PR. It requires the Closes line and that "the test workflow check for the head commit succeeded".
